event.name: Break my Product 2.0
event.description:
Real users. Tougher testing. Better products.

Built something and want brutally honest feedback before your next launch?

We are back with an improved format designed to help founders uncover hidden issues, validate assumptions, and ship with confidence.

Whether you're building an MVP, AI product, startup, side project, or prototype, this session gives you direct access to thoughtful testers who aren't afraid to ask hard questions.

How it works:

Bring a product, prototype, MVP, or side project.
Get matched with fellow founders, builders, designers, and creators.
Watch as they explore, test, question, and intentionally try to break your product.
Receive candid, actionable feedback on usability, onboarding, messaging, UX, positioning, and overall product experience.
Return the favor by testing someone else's product and sharing your own insights.

This isn't a demo day—it's a collaborative product stress test.

You'll leave with:

Fresh perspectives from real users.
A clearer understanding of where people get stuck.
Actionable improvements you can implement immediately.
New connections with builders who care about creating better products.

Whether you're validating an idea, polishing an MVP, preparing for launch, or iterating after your first release, this is your chance to discover what works, what doesn't, and what to fix next.
